regions.label: NotePeriodWords
regions.evidence: Twelve little-endian APU period words: PlaySoundNote masks low nibble, rejects >=12, doubles accepted index and reads $B251/$B252,Y; octave shifts follow. Fixed PRG[0,1,2,3]; structural evidence only. analysis/disassembly/round002/review.md.

regions.label: SoundDescriptors
regions.evidence: Twenty-two four-byte records: slot offset, channel mode, stream low/high (high OR $20). StartSound stride4, supported final selector $15, all slot/mode fields and first stream boundary $B319 jointly establish extent; not all IDs claimed naturally selected. Fixed PRG[0,1,2,3]; structural evidence only. analysis/disassembly/round002/review.md.

regions.label: SoundStreams
regions.evidence: Twenty-two four-byte headers followed by two-byte commands/notes and single-byte terminal $FF. Header/decoder/loop consumers and each bounded endpoint verified. Streams0..5 loop via B0,02 before trailing FF; their tail FF is not claimed executed. Stream21 consumes final FF at physical $3664; exclusive end $3665. See sound-verification.json and review.md. Fixed PRG[0,1,2,3]; structural evidence only. analysis/disassembly/round002/review.md.

regions.label: CourseUiAndRemainingSoundData
regions.evidence: Audio frequency/parameter tables and repeated music command records immediately after sound update RTS $B250; long FF run; $B700 pointer list and large repeated compressed course/UI command streams; $F3C2 pointer list and tiled/material lookup records; final uniform FF run up to interrupt vectors. Inspected each 256-byte window plus boundary bytes, all direct references from accepted code and known pointer consumers ($9266..$928F,$92A4..$92B6,$AF17,$B0E0,$B244). Repeated command/value records and uniform suffixes establish non-code; exact subformats and semantics are deliberately not claimed. No conflicting instruction-fetch or static control-flow evidence. See data-inspection.md. Static structural inference; lack of execution alone was not used. Bounds use physical offset and adjacent independently classified objects. Refinement excludes preceding verified sound schemas; generic remainder starts $3665 after final sound FF, not $3664. Fixed PRG[0,1,2,3]; structural evidence only. analysis/disassembly/round002/review.md.

regions.label: ChannelEnableMasks
regions.evidence: Four hardware-channel ownership/enable bits; masked channel index AND $03 and GuardSoundChannel/ClaimSoundChannel consumers establish extent. Fixed PRG[0,1,2,3]; structural inference, no natural selection or new execution claim. Independently verified R002-R01; analysis/disassembly/round003/review.md.

regions.label: ChannelCapabilityFlags
regions.evidence: Four capability flags read by TickSoundEngine after channel mode AND $03; flags control triangle/noise/volume paths. Fixed PRG[0,1,2,3]; structural inference, no natural selection or new execution claim. Independently verified R002-R01; analysis/disassembly/round003/review.md.

regions.label: VibratoOffsets
regions.evidence: Three sixteen-phase signed vibrato banks. Accepted 22-stream selectors yield offsets $00,$10,$20; A3 argument AND $70 combined with frame AND $0F. Unrestricted engine selectors are not asserted to have arrays. Fixed PRG[0,1,2,3]; structural inference, no natural selection or new execution claim. Independently verified R002-R01; analysis/disassembly/round003/review.md.

regions.label: NonzeroEnvelopeAmplitudes
regions.evidence: Two sixteen-phase nibble-amplitude banks for encoded envelope IDs1/2. Four-iteration phase loop yields nibble0..15. CPU EnvelopeAmplitudes=$B291 is a biased base overlapping third vibrato bank; ID0 bypasses access, actual bank1 starts $B2A1. End independently bounded by descriptors at $B2C1. Fixed PRG[0,1,2,3]; structural inference, no natural selection or new execution claim. Independently verified R002-R01; analysis/disassembly/round003/review.md.
